oracle.scope: complete declared namespace and exhaustive current canonical inode-table membership, exact kinds, modes and mtime, canonical inode continuity, logical length and every final byte from an independent splice model, plus current-format untouched payload-ID/source-offset retention transcript on a fresh published-root mount and through typed/authenticated public persisted-root readers
oracle.omissions: retired canonical encoding byte/root-ID identity is not compared with current format; unreferenced non-inode object census remains unavailable

differences: P-3: the frozen singular public SDK range edit becomes exact ordinary in-place positional filesystem writes through one shared writer, followed by one existing public Workspace Commit. Growth/shrink shifts the untouched suffix through ordinary reads/writes; no retired SDK-only latency or zero-FUSE-write claim is made.

The retired SDK edit route and this ordinary-write route use different canonical formats. Independent splice verification retains untouched payload-ID/source-offset semantics within the current format using the pristine current Store as its base; current typed grammar and exhaustive canonical inode-table membership are verified. Retired encoding byte identity and historical canonical root IDs are not treated as current-format oracles.

Global Store is opened directly by the Linux daemon from its shared volume under explicitly selected Disposable/WAL/OFF. The frozen host Store topology and pure-call clocks remain archival; the port records its actual mount/command/Commit/unmount clocks.

One sample with campaign seed1 replaces the historical five-repetition rotation for this iteration; deterministic fixture and replacement byte seeds, single edit, ordering and final size remain unchanged.

Class B uses an untimed prior mount executing the identical ordinary syscall body without Commit, then terminal unmount/automatic cleanup and a fresh measured mount. Actual measured source-demand counters must be zero or the number is INELIGIBLE. Zero immutable source demands alone are insufficient for a Committed row: independent pre-Commit own-write backing coldness must also be verified. An unavailable own-write cache observation leaves the numeric row INELIGIBLE; functional completion, verification and cleanup are separate.

The complete separate proof retains the original selected-verification policy of 45 s work and 59 s hard watchdog. Current public typed/authenticated readers validate a closed exported Store in an independent offline proof, outside all product timers.

The original two-second edit/Commit/End group watchdog is retained and actively enforced as edit_commit_end_watchdog_ms=2000, beginning immediately before the measured ordinary command through Commit and terminal unmount. It excludes setup, prior warm-up, measured mount and independent proof. Every group operation uses the remaining group time; expiry retains a failed receipt and uncertain resources rather than falling back to the general 120 s watchdog.

Owner O-9 / D-4 (#319, 2026-10-11): the 2000 ms watchdog surrounds Commit only; command and terminal unmount use the ordinary uncapped operation watchdog. Historical edit/Commit/End declaration retained as provenance.
